# Entropia Ventures

> Lead conversion systems for service businesses in the US and Mexico.

Entropia Ventures installs a lead conversion system in service businesses: instant response, qualification, routing, booking, follow-up, deal tracking, and monthly improvement (Track A). Visibility work — SEO, Google Business Profile, content, and local ads — is a separate, optional add-on (Track B). Entropia Ventures also publishes free public audits showing how businesses currently handle inbound leads and where they leak.

## Audit Registry

- [All Audits](https://entropia.ventures/audits/) — Browse 185+ free visibility audits by category and location.
